name: execution_output_synthesize
content: Synthesize the execution-scoped agent output from the following structured bundle.
1. Choose exactly one `media_type` from `allowed_media_types` in the bundle. Prefer `preferred_media_type` unless another allowed type is clearly better.
2. Summarize the execution result for agent/runtime consumption.
3. Identify the most important outputs or child results that shaped the outcome.
4. Note any important remaining caveats or follow-up hooks when they exist in the bundle.
5. Keep the output concise, factual, and reusable by another agent.
Respond with ONLY valid JSON using this shape:
If you choose `application/json`, set `body_json` instead of `body_text`.

variables.name: bundle_section
variables.description: Structured execution synthesis bundle wrapped in <synthesis_bundle> tags
